settings.title: Settings
settings.subtitle: Manage your configuration
settings.noPermission: You do not have permission to access settings.
settings.appearanceHint: Choose the global app look. This affects pages, modals, menus, tables and tooltips.
settings.yourPreferenceHint: If allowed, you can override the global setting for your own account. Your choice is saved and will persist after restart.
settings.sectionsHint: Enable or disable sidebar sections globally. Disabled pages stay visible in the sidebar as unavailable, and users already inside one are redirected to the dashboard unless they have override permission.
settings.sectionEnabledHint: Visible for all clients with permission.
settings.sectionDisabledHint: Disabled globally. Sidebar entries stay visible but cannot be opened unless the user has override permission.
settings.sectionDisabledModalMessage: {{section}} has been disabled by an administrator. You have been redirected to the dashboard.
settings.translationsHint: Edit translation values for the selected language. Changes apply after you save.
settings.globalDefaultLanguageHint: This is the default language for users without a personal override.
settings.saveChangesHint: Click Save Changes in the Settings page to apply global defaults.
settings.yourLanguageHint: If allowed, you can override the global language for your own account.
settings.translationsKeysHint: Below are all translation keys. Left column = key (e.g. settings.title), right = value for the language chosen above. Use Save Changes at the bottom to persist.
settings.scheduledReportsHint: Send an email digest of submitted reports on a schedule.
settings.mailSendingHint: If disabled, the app will not send any emails (welcome email, etc.).
settings.transportDefaultHint: Leave empty to use the transport default.
settings.extraChargesDesc: Charges available when creating a driver cashout. Each is deducted from the cashout amount like violations.
settings.lockAfterFailedAttempts: Lock account after failed login attempts
settings.lockAfterFailedAttemptsHint: When enabled, accounts are locked after a set number of failed login attempts. A user with the unlock permission must unlock the account.
settings.notifyOutsideCountry: Notify when user logs in from outside allowed country
settings.notifyOutsideCountryHint: When enabled, users with the notify permission see a modal when someone logs in from outside the allowed country. You can then lock the account and kick them to the login screen.
settings.allowedCountryCode: Allowed country code (e.g. IQ for Iraq)
settings.aiAssistantHint: When enabled, the floating AI chat button is visible for all online users. When disabled, the button is hidden and any open chat panel will close.
settings.globalChatLockHint: When enabled, only users with the bypass permission can send messages in the global chat channel.
settings.globalChatPermissionHint: Users with this permission can still send in global chat while it is locked.
settings.arqamLowCreditAlertHint: Alert users with Arqam view permission when credit is equal to or lower than the threshold.
settings.arqamLowCreditThresholdHint: Alert when credit is less than or equal to this value.
settings.arqamViewPermissionHint: Users with this permission can see Arqam credit on dashboard and receive low-credit alerts.
settings.maintenanceHint: When on, only users with maintenance permission can use the app. Everyone else sees a message that the system is under maintenance.

gaming.mafiaDesc: Classic Mafia (Werewolf). Night and day phases, roles, voting.
gaming.shareCode: Share the game code so others can join
gaming.botsHint: Add bots to test with fewer people. Bots play automatically during the game.
gaming.rule1: 6–18 players. Roles: Mafia (minority), Villagers (majority), Doctor (optional from 9+ players).
gaming.rule2: Night: Mafia choose one player to kill. Doctor may save one player (including themselves).
gaming.rule3: Day: Everyone sees who died. Discuss and vote to lynch one player. Majority wins; tie = no lynch.
gaming.rule4: Village wins when all Mafia are dead. Mafia wins when they outnumber the village.
gaming.rule5: Your role is secret until you are dead or the game ends.
gaming.chatDisabledDead: Only living players can send messages.
gaming.noLeaderboardYet: No games played yet. Play Mafia to see the leaderboard.
gaming.backgammonDesc: Classic 1v1. Roll dice, move checkers, bear off first to win.
